children.value: > Fact From Story: OpenAI recently connected ChatGPT to the internet for all users.
> > Fact From Story: OpenAI launched plugins for ChatGPT, extending the bot’s functionality by granting it access to third-party knowledge sources and databases, including the web.

> > > Fact From Story: Available in alpha to ChatGPT users and developers on the waitlist, OpenAI says that it’ll initially prioritize a small number of developers and subscribers to its premium ChatGPT Plus plan before rolling out larger-scale and API access.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies often release products to a smaller audience before a full release.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Connecting to the internet allows access to more information.
> Fact From Story: Here’s a timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.

> > Fact From Story: OpenAI re-opens ChatGPT Plus subscriptions After pausing ChatGPT Plus subscriptions in November due to a “surge of usage,” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced they have once again enabled sign-ups. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: we have re-enabled chatgpt plus subscriptions! 🎄 thanks for your patience while we found more gpus. — Sam Altman (@sama) December 13, 2023
> > > Fact From Story: The Plus subscription includes access to GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Re-enabling a subscription indicates an update or change to the product.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies often offer subscriptions to access premium content. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: Companies often update their products to improve them.
